scenes.text: It's Friday, five in the afternoon. Your tech just fixed Tom's A-C, and Tom loved him.
Nobody asks for a review. Tom forgets by dinner. And your newest review is from March.
Your next customer reads those reviews before they ever call you.
So you automate it. But careful. Google's rules say you can't only ask the happy customers.
An hour after the job, Tom gets one text. Everyone gets your review link. If Tom says it went badly, your office also calls him.
Ask everyone. Then fix the unhappy ones yourself.
Follow. I fix one business process like this every week.
